---
title: "Dashboard"

---

```{r include=FALSE}
library(p8105.datasets)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
```

```{r include=FALSE}
data(rest_inspec)

rest_df = rest_inspec |> 
 rename(borough = boro) |> 
  filter(
    borough != "0",
    grade %in% c("A", "B", "C")
  )
```
<br>

## Manhattan Restaurant Health Inspection Grades 
```{r echo=FALSE}
rest_df |> 
  filter(
    borough == "Manhattan",
    !is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude),
    latitude != 0, longitude != 0
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    text_label = str_c("Restaurant: ", dba, "\nGrade: ", grade)
  ) |> 
  plot_ly(
    x = ~longitude, y = ~latitude, type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
    color = ~grade, colors = "viridis", text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.5
  )
```


## Percentage of Restaurants with C grades in Manhattan by Cuisine
```{r echo=FALSE, out.width = "100%"}
rest_df |> 
  filter(borough == "Manhattan") |> 
  mutate(
    cuisine_description = recode(
      cuisine_description, 
      "Latin (Cuban, Dominican, Puerto Rican, South & Central American)" = "Latin",
      "Ice Cream, Gelato, Yogurt, Ices" = "Frozen desserts"
    )
  ) |> 
  group_by(cuisine_description) |> 
  summarize(
    total_n = n(),
    c_count = sum(grade == "C", na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_c = (c_count / total_n) * 100
  ) |> 
  filter(c_count > 0) |> 
  mutate(cuisine_description = fct_reorder(cuisine_description, percent_c),
    text_label = str_c(cuisine_description, ": ", round(percent_c, 2), "%")) |> 
  plot_ly(x = ~cuisine_description, y = ~percent_c, type = "bar", color = ~cuisine_description, colors = "viridis", text = ~text_label,
    hoverinfo = "text") |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Cuisine",
      tickangle = -45, 
      tickfont = list(size = 7)  
    ),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Percentage of Restaurants with C Grades"
    ))


```

## Distribution of Restaurant Health Inspection Scores Among Restaurants with C Grades Across Boroughs
### (Higher Scores = More / Worse Violations)
```{r echo=FALSE}
rest_df |> 
  mutate(borough = fct_reorder(borough, score)) |> 
  filter(grade == "C",
         score >= 0) |> 
  plot_ly(y = ~score, color = ~borough,
          type = "box", colors = "viridis") |> 
  layout(
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Borough"),
    yaxis = list(
      title = "Health Inspection Score"
    ))
```
